jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

EPEX SPOT SE is a leading European power exchange operating physical short-term electricity markets across Central Western Europe, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, the Nordics, and Poland. The company is committed to fostering the integration of renewable energy sources and promoting consumer and producer engagement through innovative market solutions such as local flexibility markets and Guarantees of Origin auctions. Dedicated to supporting decarbonization, decentralization, and digitalization, EPEX SPOT plays a vital role in shaping the future of the European power market. The organization values diversity, innovation, and continuous improvement, creating an inclusive environment that encourages professional growth and collaboration. With a focus on sustainability and the energy transition, EPEX SPOT offers a dynamic workplace where talented individuals can thrive and make a meaningful impact on the global energy landscape.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Data Engineer to join our team and lead the development of EPEX SPOT's cloud-native Data Platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). In this strategic role, you will combine technical expertise with leadership capabilities to design, build, and enhance scalable, reliable, and AI-ready data solutions that support our business operations, analytics, and innovation initiatives. You will act as a technical leader within the Data Platform team, mentoring and coaching Data Engineers, driving engineering best practices, and facilitating the adoption of advanced data platform capabilities such as BigQuery, Dataform, Dataplex, Dataflow, BigLake, and Vertex AI. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Product Owners, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Security, and Architecture teams, you will ensure the platform's reliability, security, and scalability. Your efforts will directly contribute to EPEX SPOT’s strategic goals of leveraging data and AI to accelerate energy transition efforts, optimize operations, and foster innovation across the organization.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field
Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related disciplines
Proven experience in building and operating cloud-native data platforms, preferably on Google Cloud Platform
Strong hands-on expertise with GCP data services including BigQuery, Dataform, Dataflow, Dataplex, BigLake, and Vertex AI
Experience with data lake and lakehouse architectures, external tables, and data governance frameworks
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and SQL
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, preferably Terraform
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL architecture, API-based data integration, and real-time streaming solutions
Knowledge of data quality, metadata management, and data lineage practices
Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools within GCP, including Gemini in BigQuery and Gemini Code Assist
Ability to lead and mentor technical teams, promote engineering best practices, and foster a culture of continuous improvement
Proven experience working in Agile environments and collaborating across multiple teams
Certifications such as Google Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Machine Learning Engineer are preferred

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy scalable enterprise data pipelines and data products to support analytics, AI, and business operations
Build robust batch and streaming data processing solutions ensuring platform performance, security, and cost efficiency
Support architecture decisions and execute the technical roadmap for the data platform
Act as a technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges, providing innovative solutions
Coach and mentor Data Engineers, fostering technical growth and adherence to engineering standards
Conduct code and design reviews, promoting best practices and knowledge sharing within the team
Implement data governance capabilities using Google Dataplex, ensuring compliance with security and privacy regulations
Support metadata management, data lineage, cataloging, and data quality initiatives to deliver trusted data assets
Enable self-service analytics by developing reusable, governed data products for end-users
Collaborate effectively within Agile teams, promoting DevOps and DataOps practices to ensure platform reliability and continuous delivery
Contribute to AI and Machine Learning initiatives by building data foundations and supporting integration with Vertex AI and related services

Benefits

Flexible hybrid working arrangements, including options for remote work to promote work-life balance
Dedicated annual training budget for continuous professional development and upskilling
Clear career progression pathways within EPEX SPOT and the broader EEX Group
Opportunities for internal mobility across different roles and teams
Participation in leadership development programs and recognition initiatives
Inclusive workplace culture that values diversity and promotes gender equality
Modern remote and hybrid work setup supporting flexible working conditions
Access to a vibrant, international team dedicated to innovation and sustainability in energy markets

Equal Opportunity

EPEX SPOT is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We believe that diversity enhances our innovation and effectiveness, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and equal opportunity for everyone. Our commitment extends to ensuring a supportive environment where all individuals can develop their skills and achieve their full potential.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
A leading Belgian organisation is building a next-generation AI platform designed to enable employees to securely leverage artificial intelligence across the business. The platform will provide a centralised environment for developing, deploying and governing AI solutions, with a strong focus on scalability, security and responsible AI practices.

As a Senior Data Engineer
, you will join a newly established engineering team responsible for building the data and knowledge foundations that power AI applications, assistants and intelligent search experiences across the organisation.

This is a hands-on Data Engineering role focused on creating scalable ingestion pipelines, retrieval systems and enterprise data integrations. You will play a critical role in transforming structured and unstructured business data into trusted, governed and searchable knowledge that can be consumed by AI solutions at scale.

The Role

You will be responsible for designing and maintaining the data pipelines and retrieval infrastructure that power enterprise AI applications.
Working closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers and Platform Engineers, you will build the systems that ingest, classify, enrich and index information from across the business. Your work will ensure AI applications can access high-quality, well-governed and permission-aware data in a secure and scalable way.
You will play a key role in developing enterprise search capabilities, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) data pipelines, embedding frameworks, metadata management processes and data governance controls that underpin the organisation's AI strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop data ingestion pipelines for enterprise knowledge and AI platforms.
Build parsing, transformation and enrichment pipelines for documents, PDFs, images and structured data sources.
Develop chunking, embedding and indexing frameworks to support enterprise search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) use cases.
Build and optimise Elasticsearch-based search platforms and retrieval services.
Implement entitlement-aware data models and metadata frameworks to ensure secure access to information.
Integrate enterprise data catalogues and governed data products into the AI platform.
Develop and maintain data quality, validation and lineage processes across knowledge and search ecosystems.
Create integrations with enterprise applications, databases, document repositories and legacy systems.
Build scalable data pipelines using Python, SQL and modern ELT frameworks.
Work with AI Engineers to improve retrieval performance, search relevance and knowledge grounding.
Drive best practices around data governance, classification, ownership and information lifecycle management.
Support the ongoing evolution of search, retrieval and data platform capabilities across the organisation.

Requirements

Essential

4+ years of commercial Data Engineering experience.
Strong Python and SQL development skills.
Experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines and ELT workflows.
Strong understanding of data modelling, data quality and data lineage principles.
Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or similar search technologies.
Experience designing and managing large-scale data ingestion and indexing frameworks.
Understanding of metadata management, data governance and data catalogue concepts.
Experience working with enterprise data sources including databases, document repositories, SharePoint and messaging systems.
Knowledge of semantic search, embeddings or modern information retrieval concepts.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices including testing, CI/CD and monitoring.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work within cross-functional engineering teams.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field.

Desirable

Experience working on AI or Generative AI platforms.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Experience building embedding pipelines and vector search solutions.
Familiarity with enterprise data catalogue and governance tooling.
Experience within financial services or other highly regulated industries.
Exposure to legacy platforms or mainframe integrations.
Knowledge of containerised environments such as Kubernetes or OpenShift.
Dutch language skills are advantageous, with French considered a plus.

What's on Offer

Opportunity to join a high-impact AI transformation programme.
Work on the data foundations underpinning enterprise AI initiatives.
Collaborate with experienced engineers, architects and AI specialists.
Significant ownership of search, retrieval and knowledge platform capabilities.
Exposure to large-scale data engineering and information management challenges.
Long-term career progression within a growing Data & AI function.
Modern technology environment with substantial investment in innovation and AI.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
Company car or mobility budget.
Bonus, insurance and additional holiday benefits.
Office-based environment with close collaboration across technical teams.

This role would suit a Senior Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Search Engineer, Information Retrieval Engineer or Knowledge Platform Engineer
looking to work on large-scale data platforms that support the next generation of enterprise AI solutions.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About XTEL

XTEL is a leading global revenue management solutions provider for consumer goods companies (CPG). We help our clients' businesses grow smarter, every day, through our holistic and proven digitalisation and change management approach. By combining state‑of‑the‑art technology, deep industry expertise, and a proven approach to data and change management, XTEL's Revenue Management suite supports CPGs towards value realisation and profitable revenue growth

Position Overview

As a Data Engineer at XTEL, you will work directly on client solutions and oversee the health of our delivery processes within our AI-driven SaaS platform for the CPG/FMCG market. Through a structured onboarding and training programme, you will gain hands-on expertise across our deployed solutions, taking ownership of both scheduled maintenance activities and on-demand tasks such as troubleshooting, data validation, and change request implementation. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep our AI systems healthy, valuable, and explainable — while managing feedback flows that drive continuous improvement and resilience.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Solution Setup: Perform the technical configuration and initial setup of XTEL's AI solutions for new clients, ensuring a smooth and accurate onboarding experience.
Routine Maintenance: Handle bug fixes, system upgrades, and scheduled health checks to keep client installations running reliably and efficiently.
Change Request Implementation: Analyse and implement special maintenance tasks and change requests, adapting software configurations to meet evolving client needs.
Ticketing & Issue Resolution: Manage and resolve client needs and technical issues through a structured ticketing system, ensuring timely and effective responses.
Data Pipeline Health: Monitor and maintain the integrity of data sources, pipelines, and delivered solutions; lead troubleshooting and debugging workflows to resolve incidents proactively.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Project and Product teams to report solution feedback, flag recurring issues, and contribute to continuous improvement of XTEL's platform.
Process Resilience: Contribute to a proactive delivery culture by identifying risks early, documenting findings, and supporting the development of scalable operational processes.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a STEM discipline, or a related field.
3-5 years of relevant experience in Data Management, Data Science or Analytics.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience using data manipulation libraries (NumPy, pandas).
Proficiency in English (written and spoken).
Solid understanding of coding practices and software development fundamentals.
Demonstrated ability to work in a client-facing technical environment, managing both scheduled and unplanned tasks.

Nice to Have:

Strong analytical skills with a critical thinking and problem-solving mindset.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with DevOps practices and the Azure Cloud ecosystem.
Exposure to data management, data science, or analytics in a professional context.

Personal Attributes:

Client-oriented mindset: You approach client interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism — understanding that behind every ticket is a business need that matters.
Clear communicator: You can translate technical findings into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, and you know when to escalate versus when to resolve independently.
Proactive and ownership-driven: You take initiative, follow through on commitments, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.
Collaborative team player: You thrive in cross-functional environments, building trusted relationships with colleagues across Project, Product, and Client teams.
Adaptable and curious learner: You embrace new tools, processes, and domains with a can-do attitude, and you are comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Detail-oriented and reliable: You take quality seriously — whether it's a data validation, a bug fix, or a client-facing update — and you consistently deliver work that others can depend on.

What We Offer:

Hybrid working set-up (HQ in Leuven);🏡
Flexible working hours;⌚
Competitive Salary Package ;💸
A challenging role in a fast-growing AI-driven company; 🪄
A diverse and international team with strong ownership and a can-do mentality.🌏
Opportunities to contribute meaningfully to the organization’s growth and development.🚀

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

If you have strengths to share, we'd love to hear from you. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, so don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet all criteria.
XTEL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
